name: Vivekanand
title: Senior Software Engineering Manager | Ex-Myntra | Ex-Goldman Sachs | Ex-Flipkart
bio: Experienced Software Engineer with extensive experience in developing products and applications, building distributed frameworks, and designing distributed system architectures.

experience.description: Leading software engineering teams and technical strategy.
Served as Associate Director driving engineering initiatives.
Managed engineering teams and built scalable distributed systems.
Vice President role driving software architecture and platform development.

Designed and developed Flipkart Catalogue Management System features (Retro and Auto QC) to reduce product listing turnaround time. Led the design and implementation of Federated Architecture for Flipkart Cloud Platform (Storage as a Service) using Ceph.
Worked on a distributed transactional framework providing transaction atomicity, network state backup/restore, system recovery, and performance monitoring.
Developed code for IPC framework for inter-process communication in Evolution middleware for video streaming. Integrated Qt and PhoneMe.
Wrote C++ code for real-time fraud detection server in telecom services, developed statistical rule modules, and wrote PL/SQL packages.

projects.title: Flipkart Catalogue Management System (Retro and Auto QC)
projects.description: Redesigned catalogue system pipeline for product listings to reduce turnaround time using ML-based intelligence systems and automated quality check models.

projects.title: Federated Architecture for Flipkart Cloud Platform (SaaS)
projects.description: Designed and deployed Enterprise-class S3 cloud storage on-premise using Ceph. Implemented hybrid SSD/HDD architecture, dynamic traffic routing across clusters, real-time data migration service, and health monitoring frameworks.

projects.title: Evolution Middleware IPC Framework
projects.description: Developed inter-process communication framework APIs for video streaming middleware and integrated Qt with PhoneMe.

projects.title: Real-Time Fraud Detection Application
projects.description: Developed server-side C++ components and PL/SQL packages for monitoring VOICE, GPRS, SMS, and MMS telecom services.
